diagnosticReview.symptom: A large mobile puddle collects at a stroke’s end
conditionalCauses: More liquid delivered than the small area can hold
A steep incline or overly wet starting surface
diagnosticReview.check: Did a drop hang from the loaded brush? Was there already standing water, or did gravity carry the wash downhill?
diagnosticReview.correction: If everything is still wet and freely flowing, rinse and blot a brush until damp, then touch only the excess pool and lift away. Blot again before repeating. On the next fresh patch, reduce load or inclination, choosing just one change and keeping concentration steady.
diagnosticReview.stop: If the surrounding wash is losing sheen or resisting flow, stop. Let it dry and repeat on fresh scrap instead of dragging the pool through it.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: The brush runs dry before the stroke ends
conditionalCauses: Only the tip was loaded, or the brush reservoir is too small for the area
Absorbent paper, a sticky mixture or a stroke longer than the current load can supply
diagnosticReview.check: Was the belly wetted and loaded, or only the point dipped in paint? Did a continuous beginning become depleted, or did gaps occur from the start?
diagnosticReview.correction: On fresh scrap, first test a properly wetted and loaded belly over the same stroke length. If it still runs out, make a separate shorter-stroke test. A larger suitable brush is another option to test separately.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not press harder or scrub a drying mark to stretch it. Leave it and restart the comparison.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: A hard line separates successive wash passes
conditionalCauses: The previous edge dried before the join
A gap between passes, inconsistent delivery or a change in mixture concentration
diagnosticReview.check: Was the advancing edge still freely wet at the join? Did you pause to remix, leave a gap or reload from a different concentration?
diagnosticReview.correction: If a pause let the edge dry, premix enough colour and repeat on a fresh rectangle of the same size. If you still cannot maintain the join, try a smaller area in a separate attempt. Overlap the workable wet edge rather than brushing a drying line.
diagnosticReview.stop: Once the line is setting, let it dry. Repeatedly brushing it may worsen the join or disturb the paper.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

conditionalCauses: Standing surface water or a wetter brush load than expected
Paper sizing and absorption differ from the comparison sheet
diagnosticReview.check: Look across the surface: was it evenly damp or carrying a reflective pool? Was the second load comparable?
diagnosticReview.correction: Leave the current mark. If you observed standing water, compare a fresh evenly damp patch without a pool, using the same mixture and load. If the surface was already evenly damp, test a smaller load separately. Observe the result; spread is material-dependent.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not chase the spreading pigment with repeated wet strokes. Start a fresh comparison if the surface becomes unevenly dry.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: A lighter irregular bloom with a darker rim forms in a wash
conditionalCauses: A comparatively wetter addition displaced pigment in a partly drying passage
A wet edge or nearby pool fed back into it
diagnosticReview.check: Was the wash losing sheen before the addition? Was there a wetter pool at the tape or edge?
diagnosticReview.correction: Leave the forming bloom alone. On fresh scrap, repeat with the second mark earlier in a workable wash or with more comparable liquid loads; choose one change per test.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not scrub or keep adding water to make the bloom disappear. Let the passage dry and judge whether its texture can remain.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: A passage looks dirty, streaked or physically disturbed
conditionalCauses: Repeated brushing into a setting wash
Dirty rinse water, many pigment additions or damaged sizing
diagnosticReview.check: Was the colour already mixed on the palette, or repeatedly altered on paper? Are fibres lifting or the surface roughening? Is the colour merely neutral, or is the surface physically disturbed?
diagnosticReview.correction: Stop touching the area. Test a clean premixed colour with clean water and fewer passes on fresh paper before deciding on any later painting adjustment.
diagnosticReview.stop: Stop immediately if the sheet abrades or resists the brush. Drying is not a promise that an opaque, stained or damaged passage can be restored.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: The dry swatch is unexpectedly lighter or darker
conditionalCauses: Wet and dry appearances were compared
Concentration, liquid deposit, pigment properties or paper absorption varied
diagnosticReview.check: Are both samples dry under similar light? Did you change concentration and load together, or carry extra rinse water into a puddle?
diagnosticReview.correction: Make a labelled fresh pair using the same pigment and comparable loading. Change concentration only; compare after drying before choosing a painting mixture.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not keep adding colour to a partly drying swatch to chase its expected value. Let it dry and make a new test.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

conditionalCauses: Textured paper catches only part of the contact
Insufficient load, fast movement or uneven brush contact
diagnosticReview.check: Do gaps follow the paper’s peaks? Is the beginning continuous but the end depleted? Compare a repeat using the same load and a steadier contact on fresh paper of the same type.
diagnosticReview.correction: On fresh scrap adjust one of load, contact or speed. If a smoother passage is needed, reduce the area or test a suitable smoother paper separately.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not grind the brush into the sheet to fill every gap. Stop if the surface is abrading or the wash is setting.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: A colourful object was assigned the darkest family without a tonal comparison
conditionalCauses: Hue intensity was used as a substitute for relative lightness
The surrounding light changed
diagnosticReview.check: Compare the object with its immediate neighbours under the same light. Is it darker, or mainly more saturated?
diagnosticReview.correction: On a fresh tiny plan assign families using neighbouring lightness comparisons, keeping the crop unchanged.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not darken the physical painting just to make a colour label fit. Re-observe or record uncertainty.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: The thumbnail breaks into many unrelated spots
conditionalCauses: Small details were mapped before large groups
Too many small variations were assigned separate families
diagnosticReview.check: At arm's length, can you still point to a main light and a connected middle group?
diagnosticReview.correction: Make a fresh smaller plan with fewer boundaries. Group close variations before restoring any accent.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not thicken every outline or fill every light gap to rescue the current drawing.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: The dark group dominates a plan intended to be quiet
conditionalCauses: Dark area expanded while details were added
Its contrast or isolation is stronger than intended
diagnosticReview.check: Did both versions retain comparable dark area and the same crop?
diagnosticReview.correction: If the position test is complete, try a separate smaller-dark-area plan and name that new variable.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not change area, value and subject position together and attribute the result to one cause.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: The supposedly lost contour is still a clear line or pale gap
conditionalCauses: Neighbouring dry values differ
A white gap or darker setting seam separates the passages
diagnosticReview.check: After drying, is there an abrupt or gradual visible transition at the interval you intended to lose?
diagnosticReview.correction: Match values on fresh scrap first, then make a new small pair that meets along one workable interval without a gap.
diagnosticReview.stop: Leave a setting seam alone. Repeated rubbing or late wet additions can damage the surface or create a backrun.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: Proportions disagree each time the subject is checked
conditionalCauses: Head position, reach or reference crop changed
Different comparison methods were mixed
diagnosticReview.check: Are you looking from the same place with the pencil held at a comparable reach? Did the reference crop move?
diagnosticReview.correction: Stabilise the viewpoint and recheck one width/height relationship on fresh light lines.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not keep stretching the drawing to fit observations from different viewpoints.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: Every diagonal converges convincingly but the building reads oddly
conditionalCauses: Edges from different spatial directions were grouped together
An assumed horizon or stock box replaced observation
diagnosticReview.check: Does each chosen pair really run in the same direction on the subject? A roof slope may not belong with a wall's eave/sill pair.
diagnosticReview.correction: On a fresh few-line study separate the direction groups and re-observe one pair at a time.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not add windows or force stronger convergence to hide an uncertain main plane.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: The intended river or sky light has been filled unintentionally
conditionalCauses: Reserved shapes were not planned before the wash
Small corrective marks gradually consumed the light
diagnosticReview.check: Is the passage actually dry, and does the remaining light still serve the intention? Does your pigment lift safely on a separate dry sample?
diagnosticReview.correction: First consider accepting the changed design. If a lifting test on spare paper is safe, treat it as a separate possible method, not a guaranteed restoration of clean paper.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not scrub a fragile passage to force paper white back. Start a new small study if that light is essential.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: Hill and near bank compete without a clear intended relationship
conditionalCauses: Values, edges and saturation were increased together
Small dark details fragmented the nearer group
diagnosticReview.check: Compare the dry masses at arm's length. Which contrast attracts attention, and is that what the plan intended?
diagnosticReview.correction: Make a fresh tiny plan changing only one value or edge relationship. Test any later painting adjustment on scrap before applying it.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not darken every near edge or wash over the hill while it is setting to enforce a distance formula.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

diagnosticReview.symptom: Each finishing mark creates another area that seems to need detail
conditionalCauses: No visual job was assigned to the next mark
Local inspection replaced the whole-painting intention
diagnosticReview.check: Step back: does the landing already read, and are new marks competing with it?
diagnosticReview.correction: Stop the detail pass. On a separate thumbnail test one proposed accent or choose no further mark.
diagnosticReview.stop: Do not add a general dark outline or scrape wet paint to force a resolved appearance.
diagnosticReview.review: PASS for inspected conditional structure/safe next test; physical reproduction NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW

screenshots.inspection: Original generated files visually inspected; selected actual exported-app mobile/desktop screenshots inspected for layout, teaching alignment and texture. limitations: No newly inspected YouTube footage or live playback; network diagnostics deliberately not repeated.
No physical Android, screen-reader or painting/material acceptance; automated accessibility checks are not full WCAG conformance.
Generated studies illustrate plausible outcomes, not measured causes or real scans; owner artistic signoff remains open.
Landscape details show the same finished master, not a documented physical progressive sequence.
Supplied manufacturer pages returned 403 this execution; historical pilot source inspection is distinguished from new retrieval.
resolvedValidationIssues: Old sidebar-specific layout assertions updated to the intended concept/painting/inline-flow hierarchy, retaining ordering/overlap checks.
Chapter-switch browser assertion now waits for the new absolute cue and settles scrolling before clicking; unchanged single-player and disposal assertions.
Original-link assertions scoped to the active chapter because multiple legitimate chapter cards have source links.
Approved fixture preserves its selected segment without the removed panel remount; tests target the current card and current experiment.
Explicit canonical step navigation legitimately updates existing timestamps; all other progress fields compare exactly and video-only interactions compare raw records.
Deno default CA/cache errors resolved with system certificate trust and a writable temporary cache, never by disabling TLS.
